forgeDefender.projects.markdownDescription: Project folders to use instead of searching the workspace, relative to the workspace folder or absolute. A folder with an `Anchor.toml` is an Anchor project; any other is a Foundry project, run with forge's defaults when it has no `foundry.toml`. Empty: every folder with a `foundry.toml` or `Anchor.toml` is found, at any depth.

forgeDefender.paths.forge.markdownDescription: Path to `forge`. Empty: `forge` from the PATH, which goes through KeyMoat when it is installed.
